name: fixragent
description: Maintenance triage from one photo for property managers, landlords and maintenance teams: what the asset is, how urgent it is (EMERGENCY, TODAY, THIS WEEK or WHENEVER), which trade to call, and what to tell the resident.

interface.longDescription:
fixRAgent is maintenance triage for property managers, landlords and the companies that run buildings. Attach one photo of something in a building (a leak, a water heater, a boiler, an electrical panel, an appliance, damage) and fixRAgent returns a Triage Profile: what the asset is, whether a fault is visible, how urgent it is in one of four words (EMERGENCY, TODAY, THIS WEEK or WHENEVER), which trade to call, a line to say to the resident, and a link to the Triage Profile that a resident or contractor can open. The urgency word is set in code from fixed rules, so the same facts give the same urgency word.

Three tools:
• try_sample: a stored sample result, labelled SAMPLE. No photo is read.
• assess_property_photo: assesses one photo, plus the problem in the resident's own words if you have them.
• get_triage_profile: reads a saved Triage Profile back by its id, without reading the photo again.

Setup and documentation: fixragent.com/docs.

What it does not do: it is not an emergency service. A fire, a gas smell or someone hurt is a 911 call. It does not book contractors or decide insurance claims. It does not assess people, pets, vehicles, food or documents.

Privacy: fixRAgent removes location metadata from each photo on its server before the photo is read or stored. The cleaned photo is kept with its Triage Profile. Details: fixragent.com/privacy.

Made by AR Logic LLC, Ohio.
